name: EarlyBuffer
description: Early-input forgiveness assist for GD 2.2081. Buffers early jumps and fires on the first shadow-safe tick. Not an autoplayer; Safe Mode recommended.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.description: Master toggle. Also cycled to OFF by the preset hotkey.

preset.name: Preset
preset.description: Fills the default window / slack / look-ahead. Per-mode overwrites are kept. Cycle in-game with the hotkey (F6).

safe-mode.name: Safe Mode
safe-mode.description: Do not save progress / bests / percentage while the assist is enabled.

show-overlay.name: In-Level Overlay
show-overlay.description: On-screen status while playing (mode, buffer, learn, VERIFY/UNSAFE, perf, saves). Off = no in-level overlay. Pause bake/assist buttons are separate.

debug-logging.name: Debug Logging
debug-logging.description: Log SAVED lines and planner decisions to the Geode console.

show-trajectory.name: Trajectory Visualizer
show-trajectory.description: Draw predicted paths: gray=no click, green=earliest window, yellow=nominal, red=latest. Shows how big the click window is. Toggle: Ctrl+Shift+T.

show-pause-bake.name: Pause Bake Status
show-pause-bake.description: Show compact mode/bake status lines on the pause screen (top-left). Bake actions are under EB → Bake — no side button stacks.

show-pause-assist.name: Pause Assist Buttons (legacy)
show-pause-assist.description: Unused. Assist actions and toggles live under EB settings (Assist page + Main/Visual). Kept so old configs still load.

show-pause-hub.name: Pause EB Button
show-pause-hub.description: Show a top-right EarlyBuffer (EB) button on pause. Opens Geode settings with pages: Main, Bake, Ingame, Assist, Visual, Modes, Keys.

title-bake-actions.name: Bake Actions
title-bake-actions.description: Import a replay, bake windows, or cancel. Shown on the Bake settings page.

import-bake-replay.name: Import Bake Replay
import-bake-replay.description: Pick a GDR / MHR / SLC replay for Bake Map windows. Button shows import, or the loaded file name.

cycle-assist-mode.name: Cycle Assist Mode
cycle-assist-mode.description: Live → Replay → Hybrid → BruteForce. Button shows the current mode.

bake-map-action.name: Bake Map
bake-map-action.description: Bake click windows from the imported replay (needs Import Bake Replay first).

brute-bake-action.name: Brute Bake
brute-bake-action.description: Explore safe click timings through the level (no replay required).

cancel-bake-action.name: Cancel Bake
cancel-bake-action.description: Stop an in-progress bake. Enabled only while baking.

title-assist-actions.name: Assist Actions
title-assist-actions.description: Quick actions for preset / learning / config. Shown on the Assist settings page.

cycle-preset-action.name: Cycle Preset
cycle-preset-action.description: Tight → Normal → Wide → Max → Off. Button shows the current preset.

reset-learn-action.name: Reset Level Learning
reset-learn-action.description: Clear the auto-tune profile for the current level (bias, trust, spots).

export-config-action.name: Export Config
export-config-action.description: Save EarlyBuffer settings to a JSON file.

import-config-action.name: Import Config
import-config-action.description: Load EarlyBuffer settings from a JSON file.

save-feedback.name: Save Feedback
save-feedback.description: Cue when assist injects a delayed click. Sound = per-tick clip (+1…+7, +8+). Icon = flash player with Save Icon Color. both = sound+icon.

save-icon-color.name: Save Icon Color
save-icon-color.description: Color flashed onto the player icon when Save Feedback is icon or both.

title-scope.name: Assist Scope
title-scope.description: Where Live/Hybrid assist is allowed (practice, startpos, percent window, off-ranges). Platformer is always blocked.

assist-only-practice.name: Assist Only in Practice
assist-only-practice.description: When on, Live/Hybrid assist only runs in practice mode. Part of Assist Scope.

assist-startpos-only.name: Assist Only from Start Pos / Test
assist-startpos-only.description: When on, assist only in test/start-pos mode. Part of Assist Scope.

assist-percent-min.name: Assist Percent Min
assist-percent-min.description: Assist only at or above this percent (0–100). Pair with Assist Percent Max. Use Disable Ranges below for holes inside this window.

assist-percent-max.name: Assist Percent Max
assist-percent-max.description: Assist only at or below this percent (0–100).

title-assist-off.name: Assist Off Ranges (%)
title-assist-off.description: Inclusive percent holes where assist is forced off (inside the Assist Percent Min/Max window). -1 = unused slot.

assist-off-1-from.name: Range 1 From
assist-off-1-from.description: Start of percent window where assist is OFF. -1 = slot unused. Inclusive with Range 1 To.

assist-off-1-to.name: Range 1 To
assist-off-1-to.description: End of percent window where assist is OFF. -1 = slot unused.

ticks-all.name: Ticks (Default)
ticks-all.description: Max delay in physics ticks (~240/s, so 4 ticks ≈ 1 frame at 60fps) for every mode without an overwrite. Wave uses 'Ticks (Wave)' below.

ticks-wave.name: Ticks (Wave default)
ticks-wave.description: Default window for wave when Wave → Overwrite is off.

title-algorithm.name: Algorithm
title-algorithm.description: Planner mode, bake radius, CPS gates, budgets, press/release. Smart multi-jump is the next section.

death-slack.name: Death Slack
death-slack.description: Extra ticks of look-ahead after a planned jump (not the hazard zone). Threat clear uses clustered spike X (zoneEndX), not this. 2 is the recommended default.

look-ahead-cap.name: Look-Ahead Cap
look-ahead-cap.description: How many physics ticks each candidate is simulated. 0 = automatic (jump modes ~96, hold modes ~6× window). Higher = sees bigger gaps, more CPU.

assist-mode.name: Assist Mode
assist-mode.description: Live = plan each click. Replay = windows from imported macro. Hybrid = bake if near, else live. BruteForce = use Brute Bake map (no replay — explores safe click timings through the level).

bake-radius.name: Bake Radius
bake-radius.description: Max frames to shift each click when baking. 0 = auto (Replay/Hybrid: max(ticks,8); BruteForce: max(ticks*4,32)).

cps-limit.name: CPS Limit
cps-limit.description: Pause assist while your click rate is at or above this (clicks per second, 1s window). 0 = off. Assist turns back on when CPS drops below the limit.

min-click-interval-ms.name: Min Click Interval (ms)
min-click-interval-ms.description: If you press again within this many ms, assist skips that press (vanilla click still goes through — never blocks your input). 0 = off. Try 30–80ms.

assist-orbs.name: Orb Assist
assist-orbs.description: When on, prefer delays that activate a needed orb (activation window). Does not force decoy orbs if you are already safe. Off = threat-zone planner only.

sim-budget-us.name: Sim Budget (µs)
sim-budget-us.description: Max microseconds the planner may spend per click. On hit it shortens branches then the horizon. 0 = unlimited. 1500 ≈ 1.5ms.

tick-budget.name: Plan Tick Budget
tick-budget.description: Max physics ticks the live planner may simulate per press (deterministic). Default 4000. Exhausted budget → Pass.

assist-release.name: Assist Releases
assist-release.description: Delay or swallow jump releases (wave / ship / robot short-hops).

smart-depth.name: Smart Depth (Jumps Ahead)
smart-depth.description: How many jumps into the future Live/Hybrid may plan. 1 = classic single-click assist. 2–3 = search sequences so the first delay stays realistic further ahead. Replay/BruteForce ignore this.

smart-combos.name: Smart Combos
smart-combos.description: Max click-timing combinations tested per press when Smart Depth > 1. Higher = smarter, more CPU. Capped further by Sim Budget.

smart-horizon.name: Smart Horizon (Ticks)
smart-horizon.description: How far (physics ticks @ ~240/s) the multi-jump search simulates. 0 = auto (~180–240). Only used when Smart Depth > 1.

robust-k.name: Robust Window (±k)
robust-k.description: Neighbor ticks that must also be viable around a pick. 0 = auto from mode / speed / frame-time variance (1–3). Fixed 1 matches classic earliest±1.

robust-jitter.name: Robust firstDt Jitter
robust-jitter.description: Before committing a Delay, re-sim the top candidate with first physics dt ±3%. Rejects fragile timings under frame-time wobble. Off by default (extra sims).

title-learning.name: Learning
title-learning.description: Per-level bias/trust learning and self-bake. Window ticks are never changed by learning.

auto-tune.name: Auto-Tune Per Level
auto-tune.description: Learn bias / trust / look-ahead per level and spot as you play. The window (ticks) is never changed. Toggle: Ctrl+Shift+L. Reset current level: Ctrl+Shift+R. Profiles save under the mod save folder.

self-bake.name: Self-Bake (Practice)
self-bake.description: Record your vanilla practice clicks into the bake map (method=self). Assist injects are never recorded. Default on for practice.

self-bake-normal.name: Self-Bake in Normal Mode
self-bake-normal.description: Also record vanilla clicks outside practice. Off = practice only (recommended).

self-bake-refine.name: Self-Bake Refine Windows
self-bake-refine.description: On segment end, binary-search earliest/latest around each recorded click (budgeted, needs start snapshot, skips if assist touched the run). Off = point windows only.

assist-verify.name: Assist Verify
assist-verify.description: Debug A/B: when legacy earliest-survive disagrees with the zone/orb planner, flip a coin, log VERIFY arm + PLAN/OUTCOME (uses 2× tick budget). Prefer off for normal play.

cube-overwrite.name: Overwrite Cube
cube-overwrite.description: Use the Cube values below instead of the preset / defaults.

cube-latency.name: Cube Latency Weight
cube-latency.description: Planner prefers endX − weight·delay. Higher = earlier clicks. Cube default 0.25.

ship-latency.name: Ship Latency Weight
ship-latency.description: Planner prefers endX − weight·delay. Higher = earlier clicks. Ship default 0.75.

ball-latency.name: Ball Latency Weight
ball-latency.description: Planner prefers endX − weight·delay. Higher = earlier clicks. Ball default 0.35.

ufo-latency.name: UFO Latency Weight
ufo-latency.description: Planner prefers endX − weight·delay. Higher = earlier clicks. UFO default 0.35.

wave-latency.name: Wave Latency Weight
wave-latency.description: Planner prefers endX − weight·delay. Higher = earlier clicks. Wave default 1.0.

robot-latency.name: Robot Latency Weight
robot-latency.description: Planner prefers endX − weight·delay. Higher = earlier clicks. Robot default 0.4.

spider-latency.name: Spider Latency Weight
spider-latency.description: Planner prefers endX − weight·delay. Higher = earlier clicks. Spider default 0.4.

swing-latency.name: Swing Latency Weight
swing-latency.description: Planner prefers endX − weight·delay. Higher = earlier clicks. Swing default 0.85.

hotkey-cycle.name: Cycle Preset
hotkey-cycle.description: Cycle Tight → Normal → Wide → Max → Off.

hotkey-reset-level.name: Reset Level Learning
hotkey-reset-level.description: Clear the auto-tune profile for the current level (bias, trust, spots).

hotkey-auto-tune.name: Toggle Smart Learning
hotkey-auto-tune.description: Toggle Auto-Tune / smart learning (bias, trust, look-ahead per spot). Does not change the tick window.

hotkey-trajectory.name: Toggle Trajectory Viz
hotkey-trajectory.description: Show/hide debug trajectories and click-window paths (green earliest … red latest).

title-internal.name: Internal
title-internal.description: Kept for old configs / preset sync. Prefer the Preset dropdown and ignore these.

stage-index.name: Preset Index (internal)
stage-index.description: Internal mirror of Preset (0=Tight … 3=Max, 4=Off). Written by F6 / applyPreset — do not edit; use the Preset dropdown.

swallow-hopeless.name: Swallow If Hopeless (deprecated)
swallow-hopeless.description: Deprecated unused — the mod never blocks your clicks. Kept so old configs still load.
